results.detail: Re-derived from Extract Mislaka Files ScriptMain.cs. The file list is a snapshot taken once (Directory.GetFiles(sourcePath, zipFileName + "*.7z", SearchOption.AllDirectories), line 39) before the loop and before today's archive folder is created (line 42). archivePath = ArchivePath + yyyyMMdd (line 37). For each file: extract (Overwrite=true), archiveFullName = Path.Combine(archivePath, file name), if File.Exists(archiveFullName) File.Delete(archiveFullName) (line 51), then File.Move(zipFile, archiveFullName) (line 52). If today's archive folder lies inside the source tree, a .7z already in it is in the snapshot; archiveFullName is then the same file, so line 51 deletes it and line 52 throws FileNotFoundException. Main has no try/catch, so the Script Task fails and the remaining files in the loop are not handled. A .7z in an older dated archive folder inside the source tree matches the pattern, is re-extracted and moved into today's folder. The path values are 'fromDB' (DTSX:11-22) and loaded at runtime, so the condition is correctly stated as unknown. No contradiction with the package's other claims.
